title: Hanasato Minori — Passionate Talk!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our very own stage outfits...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is a dream come true! I can't believe we actually get to design them ourselves...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And if we end up using my design, that means I'll get to see Haruka singing and dancing while wearing it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Squeal*
That'd be beyond amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, now's not the time for that...!
This is about our outfits! This is about MMJ!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A girl can dream, right? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll start by going through the designs I've already drawn and seeing if anything will work for us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see. Where's my notebook...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, lots of ribbons would be nice...
But so would frills like this one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: However, the one I have on the next page might suit Airi and Shizuku better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait...!
I have a feeling this might be a good idea!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's get drawing! I'll use the next page to redesign it and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why's there an equation written here...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hang on... Oh noooooo!!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Just a little bit more to go, Minori!
You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori's been sobbing for a while now. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's in the middle of copying over all the designs for outfits she accidentally drew in her math notebook.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She doodled in her notebook for class...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, why's she copying them by hand? Can't she just use a copy machine?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She apparently drew them on every page and won't have enough money to buy CDs this month if she has them copied, so she's resorted to this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? You're kidding, right...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: F-Finally! I'm done...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Minori!
I know it wasn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Congrats, I guess. But you also reap what you sow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I got each design back onto its own page! That should make it easier for me to work on my idea for the design competition, so it's all good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Design competition...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Shizuku mentioned something about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that must mean she's already working on her idea too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure she's told you all about it already, but we've decided to design our own stage outfits.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're each gonna come up with a design and have our fans vote for their favorite one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still can't believe you're getting to design your own outfits.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. So, got any good ideas?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You wanna hear about my design...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let me start with... This one!
The skirt's supposed to tease everyone a little by sort of floating in the air when you dance and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is the most important part! It has three layers starting at the waistline that move differently but fluffily depending on what you do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm hoping to make it so the lengths of our skirts and their fluffiness match who we are individually!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, Haruka likes penguins and Airi likes cats, so I want to work in some animal motifs to make this outfit even cuter!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: O-Okay... I can tell you put a lot of effort into this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can? Yay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It really is a cute outfit.
Is this going to be a submission?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: About that... I'm really confident about this design but not really sure if I want this to be my submission.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I still think there are other good ideas out there, so I'm gonna keep trying out different things!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
For example, this!
A dress with pretty much no shoulders!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, this one's so much more mature!
But it's incredible how it captures that cuteness all idols possess.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: See? See?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then there's... This!
A slightly sexier outfit that shows off your midriff a little!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, this one's really cute too!
I can see why you're having such a hard time going with just one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but hang on... Why are these all blue?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, that's because...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to make sure the outfits I design look good on Haruka... Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll come up with a wonderful outfit, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna pack my design with more and more and more cuteness to make sure our fans pick it!
